title: Havre De Grace Marina

services.name: Kayak & Sup Rentals
services.desc: offer an amazingly relaxing and calming way to savor our waterfront views and wildlife! All activities are for guests 18 years of age with a signed liability waiver. If a guest is under the age of 18, a parent or guardian must also sign the liability waiver. ALL guests under the age of 18 MUST wear a PFD (personal flotation device) at ALL times while using the equipment. A 50% non-refundable credit card deposit is required to reserve a Kayak/SUP.
